shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin reclaimed $81,000 and Ethereum rallied, driving the total crypto market cap to $2.86 trillion.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw around $159.5 million in net inflows on September 17, reversing previous outflows.
Crypto markets showed resilience by absorbing the Federal Reserve's 25 basis point interest rate hike.
The Senate's CLARITY Act failed to move forward, while the CFTC introduced a new crypto regulatory proposal.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index climbed to 71, reaching a significant level of 'greed'.
